defs.def: a hollow place or structure that a bird makes or chooses for laying its eggs in and sheltering its young 鸟巢；鸟窝

ex.s: While it may lay eggs in a nest like a bird, it’s really a primitive mammal, with a unique biology.
ex.t: 虽然它可能像鸟一样在巢中产卵，但它实际上是一种原始哺乳动物，有着独特的生物学特性。

ex.s: If I could locate the nest, I might have been able to put it back, but no luck.
ex.t: 如果我能找到鸟巢，也许就能把它放回去，但运气不好，没找到。

ex.s: I put some pine branches into the basket to make this nest safe and comfortable.
ex.t: 我在篮子里放了一些松枝，让这个巢既安全又舒适。

ex.s: And it was accompanied in the nest by the greatest sight of all — LUNCH!
ex.t: 而且巢里还伴随着最壮观的景象——午餐！

ex.s: I drove over and saw the chick in the nest looking healthy and active.
ex.t: 我开车过去，看到巢里的小鸟看起来健康又活跃。

ex.s: My next work was to construct a nest and anchor it in a tree.
ex.t: 我接下来的工作是搭建一个巢并固定在树上。

defs.def: a place where insects or other small creatures live and produce their young 巢穴；窝

ex.s: The book was an early example of an adventure tale told from an animal’s point of view, by an animal with human emotions and ways of seeing the world: “Close in under the sheltering rock Buck made his nest.
ex.t: 这本书是从动物的视角讲述冒险故事的早期例子，通过一只拥有人类情感和看待世界方式的动物来叙述：＂巴克在庇护岩石下紧挨着的地方筑了他的窝。

ex.s: When she retired from dancing and her sons eventually flew the nest, she decided it was time to take the plunge.
ex.t: 当她从舞蹈事业退休，儿子们最终离巢后，她决定是时候迈出这一步了。

ex.t: 帮助改变这一现状是杰森·莫兰的工作。

ex.t: 夜 太阳西沉，晚星闪烁；鸟儿在巢中静寂无声，而我也该去寻找我的归宿。

ex.s: But when Buck finished his ration and returned, he found his nest occupied.
ex.t: 但当巴克吃完他的口粮回来时，发现他的窝被占了。

ex.s: First they collected sound data from 67 nests in four sites in Queensland before and after hatching.
ex.t: 首先，他们在孵化前后从昆士兰州四个地点的67个巢穴收集声音数据。
